description: Run a calculator and get the result. Pass the calculator's name (from search_calculators) and its input fields in args. Returns the computed values plus a share link to the calculator page with inputs pre-filled; calculators backed by a legal edition also return edition, effective_from and sources[] (document, article/clause, URL) to cite. Missing inputs are refused (isError), never defaulted. When the calculator has a formula, the result ALSO includes formula_latex — the formula with the user's values substituted; show it to the user (rendered as LaTeX when your client supports it, otherwise inline as text). Example: {"name":"bmi_calculator","args":{"unitSystem":"metric","weight":70,"height":175}}.

args.description: Input fields for the calculator (from the search result's inputSchema or get_calculator_schema).

lang.description: Optional language for labels, titles and number formatting: en, es, vi, hi, ja, ko, tr, ar, ru, fr, zh, tw, pt, de (zh = Simplified, tw = Traditional Chinese; zh-CN / zh-TW / vi-VN style tags are accepted). Default: en.

name.description: Tool name from search_calculators, e.g. compound_interest_calculator.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone of the user (e.g. Asia/Seoul, America/New_York) or offset (+09:00): date calculators count "today" in it. Default: the time zone of the lang's country (en = America/New_York).

name: run_calculator

data_used.description: Real-data figures used, with source and date.

formula_latex.description: Formula with the caller's values unless formula_values is false.

rendered_text.description: Plain-text result when main and data are empty.

url.description: Share link: the calculator page with these inputs pre-filled.
